title: Geometry of Information Rights
subtitle: Intellectual Property, Patents, Copyright, and Trademarks in the Geometric & Thermodynamic Architecture of PoLPEST

blocks.text: This chapter presents the poster “Geometry of Information Rights” in full. It is a single dense diagram; open it, then use the explanation, read-aloud, and Ask-AI tools beneath it to work through the ideas at your own pace.

blocks.alt: Poster: Geometry of Information Rights — Intellectual Property, Patents, Copyright, and Trademarks in the Geometric & Thermodynamic Architecture of PoLPEST
blocks.caption: Figure 14.1 — Geometry of Information Rights: Intellectual Property, Patents, Copyright, and Trademarks in the Geometric & Thermodynamic Architecture of PoLPEST.
blocks.explanation: Intellectual property read as thermodynamics rather than as moral entitlement. The premise is that information diffuses with zero friction while its creation costs a massive expenditure of metabolic, computational and financial free energy — so unregulated instant diffusion leaves the creator at a net loss and, if unchecked, rational agents stop expending energy on discovery at all. A patent is therefore a temporary, state-enforced topological wall around a specific set of coordinates in the intellectual state space, paired with a disclosure protocol: the creator must publish the exact schematics, so when the temporal boundary dissolves the invention irreversibly enters the public domain and the global manifold permanently expands. Copyright is read as a structural locking mechanism preserving the integrity of an ordered information sequence against entropic degradation in transmission, and as the mechanism that lets a class of agents draw metabolic sustenance from cultural work. Trademarks are fixed, high-reliability predictive priors that reduce the computational friction of evaluating every product afresh. The closing frame is the equilibrium: protect temporarily, disclose permanently.
blocks.tts: The geometry of information rights. Information wants to diffuse; IP law shapes that diffusion to harmonize individual incentive with collective destiny. Protect temporarily, disclose permanently.
